maria_sales: Hey team — prospective enterprise POC (healthcare customer). They want streaming generation + function/tool calls that emit strict JSON records (for downstream ingestion). Also need SSO + KMS, and a quick ballpark on pilot pricing. Can engineering / security confirm constraints? :wave:

devon_eng: Hi Maria — quick Qs: 1) do they need ordered per-conversation guarantees? 2) expected qps and avg token/day? 3) will the function calls need callback webhooks or inline tool results?

maria_sales: They need ordered utterances for audit, ~50 qps peak, estimate 100k–300k tokens/day during pilot. Prefer inline function results (structured JSON), but webhooks acceptable for big async jobs.

devon_eng: Great. For streaming + structured output pattern we recommend the SSE endpoint with "function_call" events and a validation schema on the client side. Minimal example (Python) for streaming + funccall parsing:```python
resp = client.stream.generate(model="redwood-rtb-1", input="Summarize...", stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    if chunk.type == "function_call":
        payload = json.loads(chunk.payload)
        # payload is {"name":..., "arguments": {...}}
```This keeps latency low and lets you validate `arguments` against a JSON schema.

alex_security: Heads-up on SSO/KMS: we can support SAML or OIDC SSO for console + API access. For API creds we suggest short-lived tokens via our token-rotation flow. KMS: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for Private and Dedicated customers. If they require on-prem HSM, escalate to enterprise sales.

jenna_ops: Observability note — enable token-level cost breakdown in the Console and route telemetry to their SIEM. For audit/order guarantees, choose Dedicated capacity and enable per-conversation affinity (session pinning) — avoids cross-worker reordering. Also TTLs on KV cache should be tuned if they call the same function with similar prefixes.

maria_sales: Rough pricing request — pilot 1 month, 100k tokens/day, streaming with function calls. Any numbers I can quote to procurement?

devon_eng: Ballpark (hosted API): streaming gen ~ $0.0008 per token (example; final price depends on model selection). So 100k tokens/day * 30 = 3M tokens -> ~$2.4k/mo. If they need strict latency + throughput SLA pick Dedicated (reserved) — expect a monthly commit starting ~$15k–25k depending on GPU pool and region. I can run a simulator if you want exact model mix.

alex_security: Add on security review lead time: SAML SSO + KMS integration typically 2–3 weeks for SOC2 customers; on-prem touches add more. Also they'll need an IP allowlist and SCIM for user sync if they want automated user provisioning.

maria_sales: Perfect. Can we get a short integration checklist I can send to the customer?

devon_eng: Yes — sending quick checklist in thread: 1) Confirm model (open vs redwood-verified) + token budget 2) Choose hosting mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) 3) Decide SSO type (SAML/OIDC) + SCIM 4) KMS choice (customer-managed or redwood-managed) 5) Webhook endpoints + certs (if using callbacks) 6) JSON schema for function outputs (attach sample) 7) Telemetry/retention needs + SIEM details 8) Pilot rollout dates and success criteria.

infra-bot: [deploy-notice] Dedicated pool sizing job queued (job id: dp-7839) — no action required unless config changes are requested.

maria_sales: Awesome — I'll package this with the security questionnaire and send to the buyer. Devon, can you follow up with the model-mix simulator? Small ask: include a cheaper quantized variant if possible.

devon_eng: Will do. I'll drop a short report by EOD with a quantized-2/4 tradeoff table and a suggested fallback policy for graceful degradation. :+1: 

maria_sales: Thanks all! :rocket:
